scripts.text:
[Skia]
Welcome!
I've been wondering when you would arrive.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
欢迎！
我一直在想您什么时候会到。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
You are here!
The people from other families all have taken their seats.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
您来了！
其他家族的人都已经入座了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
By the way.........
After I left the Banquet Hall
....No, never mind.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
顺便一提.........
在我离开宴会厅之后
....不，算了。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
Nothing good can be heard if we keep them waiting for any longer. Let's get going.
scripts.translation:
[尼希尔]
再让他们等下去也不会有好事发生。我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
^4d4dffThere is a seat left next to Lord Richard. It must be the seat reserved for an observer.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
^4d4dff理查德大人旁边还有一个空位。那应该是留给观察者的座位。^000000

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Well, let's go.
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
好了，我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
What is going on...
We shall leave this place first.
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
发生什么事了...
我们要先离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Isenhonor]
Is everyone all right...
scripts.translation:
[伊森霍纳]
大家都没事吧...

scripts.text:
[Helmut]
All seem well.
...I shall get going. The brothers don't look so good.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔穆特]
看起来大家都没事。
...我该走了。兄弟们的情况不太好。

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Phew, let's get out of here.
Sis, let's get out!
Nyhill, you should come with us!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
呼，我们快离开这里吧。
姐姐，我们快走吧！
尼希尔，你也跟我们走！

scripts.text:
[Skia]
Other people will get out on their own!
scripts.translation:
[斯基亚]
其他人会自己离开的！

scripts.text:
[Friedrich]
...There seems to be no one dead.
scripts.translation:
[弗里德里希]
...似乎没有人死亡。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Peter is in a critical condition.
...Would you mind fighting against the intruder for us?
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
彼得的情况很危急。
...您能帮我们对抗入侵者吗？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
....
.... ^4d4dffTerra Gloria^000000 is missing...
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
....
.... ^4d4dff泰拉·格洛丽亚^000000不见了...

scripts.text: Terra Gloria?
scripts.translation: 泰拉·格洛丽亚？

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
It is the crown passed down in the palace of Rune-Midgarts.
It means more than an ordinary crown.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
那是卢恩·米德加兹王宫代代相传的王冠。
它的意义远超普通的王冠。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Has it been taken by them?
What on earth...!
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
是被他们拿走了吗？
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
What is hidden here is not known to anyone... Except the seven royal families...!
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
这里隐藏的秘密无人知晓...除了七大皇族...

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Does it mean...
...Well, first things first, There are things to find out.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
难道说...
...好吧，先处理眼前的事，还有事情要调查。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Let's get out of here now.
There is much left for use to find out.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我们现在就离开这里。
还有很多事情要弄清楚。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Whoever left here, clear out with the wounded near you!
The Room of Consciousness will be closed for a while!
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
谁留在这里，就带着身边的伤员一起撤离！
意识之室将暂时关闭！

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
Peter has been wounded.
We need to move him fast.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
彼得受伤了。
我们需要尽快转移他。

scripts.text:
[Kronecker]
I'll see you out there.
You can leave through the door you have entered.
Let's meet at the Past Memories of the Royal Family.
scripts.translation:
[克罗内克]
我会在那边等你。
你可以从进来的门离开。
我们在皇族往事之地见面。

scripts.text:
[Nyhill]
...This... Is all... My fault...

[{0}]
We should watch the Ritual of Blessing.
Don't get out now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我们应该观看赐福仪式。
现在不要出去。
